self.text: I’m Tariq, a 40‑something Polish non‑binary gamer who loves the thrill of competitive play. My console is my playground, and these days it’s all Skyforge Arena for me. I’m mostly into ranked matches because the challenge keeps me sharp and the adrenaline rush is unbeatable. I’m looking for a coach—someone who can help me refine my strategies and climb the ladder. Most weeks I can find time on Saturday afternoon or Sunday afternoon to jump into the arena and work on new tactics. When I’m not fighting in the virtual world, I enjoy fermenting hot sauce in my kitchen, experimenting with flavors that keep the senses alive. It’s a hobby that mirrors the creativity I bring to gaming: mixing, testing, and perfecting until everything is just right. I thrive in high‑energy, focused environments, and I’m ready to bring that same intensity to a partnership that can help me grow. If you’re up for a Saturday or Sunday session and want to see a player who’s always ready to learn and improve, let’s connect and turn those ranked points into victories.
